historical_references.context: Ansharah were mentioned in several pre-Islamic Arabic poems and were known to have had conflicts with other tribes, including the Quraysh, who later became the tribe of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).

historical_references.reference: Ansharah also played a role in early Islamic history when they joined the army of the first Islamic caliph, Abu Bakr, during the Ridda Wars (632-633 CE). The Ridda Wars were a series of military campaigns launched by Abu Bakr to suppress rebellions in Arabian Peninsula after the death of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).
historical_references.context: Ansharah joined the Islamic army as a significant contingent and played a crucial role in the Battle of Dumat al-Jandal, which was a turning point in the Ridda Wars. The defeat of the Ansharah forces marked the end of major resistance to the early Islamic state.
